cards.titleZh: 汉谟拉比法典：裁判与证人
authors: The Avalon Project, Yale Law School (digital edition)
cards.summaryZh: 第5条处理法官的书面裁判及其责任，第9—12条围绕证人与财物归属展开。留意一场诉讼如何把证言、裁判和惩罚串在一起。
cards.summaryEn: Law 5 addresses written judgments and judicial responsibility; laws 9–12 concern witnesses and disputed property. Follow how testimony, decision, and penalty connect.
cards.scopeZh: 与阿摩利人巴比伦（公元前2000—1600年）的成文法典、法官记录对读；两项原值均为P，观察年未注明。
cards.scopeEn: Read alongside Amorite Babylonia (2000–1600 BCE): formal legal code and judges both have raw value P, with no observation date.
cards.sourceSnapshot: Yale page retrieved 2026-10-06; L. W. King translation, edition year not stated

cards.titleEn: Irrigation and damage to neighbouring fields
authors: The Avalon Project, Yale Law School (digital edition)
cards.summaryZh: 第53—56条把堤坝失修、放水灌溉和邻田受损写入法律责任。水利既是耕作条件，也牵涉邻里之间如何分担风险与赔偿损失。
cards.summaryEn: Laws 53–56 address neglected dams, irrigation, and damage to neighbouring fields. Water management links cultivation to responsibility and compensation.
cards.scopeZh: 法律设想中的灌溉活动，对应灌溉系统原值P；当前记录未注明具体观察年。
cards.scopeEn: Irrigation appears in the legal scenarios; the linked irrigation-system row has raw value P and no observation date.
cards.sourceSnapshot: Yale page retrieved 2026-10-06; L. W. King translation, edition year not stated

cards.titleZh: 商人与代理人：交易留下怎样的记录
authors: The Avalon Project, Yale Law School (digital edition)
cards.summaryZh: 商人交付货物、代理人结算和财物寄存，都涉及收据、契约或见证人。沿着第104—107、122—124条，认识交易凭证在争议中的作用。
cards.summaryEn: Deliveries, settlements, and deposits involve receipts, contracts, or witnesses. Laws 104–107 and 122–124 show how evidence enters commercial disputes.
cards.scopeZh: 条文中的凭证与契约，对应文字记录原值P；法条编号沿用耶鲁保存的英译。
cards.scopeEn: Receipts and contracts accompany the written-record row, raw value P; law numbering follows Yale’s preserved translation.
cards.sourceSnapshot: Yale page retrieved 2026-10-06; L. W. King translation, edition year not stated

cards.titleZh: 从里坊到驿传：大化诏书的行政安排
cards.titleEn: Wards and post horses in the Taika reform edict
authors: Asia for Educators, Columbia University (teaching edition)

locator.section: Longer Selection, Article II; footnote 2 on PDF page 2

cards.summaryZh: 第二条把地方官员、里坊管理和官用驿马放在同一行政方案中。顺着官员的职责与通信安排，思考朝廷怎样把命令传向地方。
cards.summaryEn: Article II connects local officers, ward administration, and official post horses. Follow how duties and communication would carry court authority into local communities.
cards.scopeZh: 646年改革诏书选段，与飞鸟时代（538—710年）的行政层级5—6、驿站P两项原记录对读。
cards.scopeEn: An excerpt contextualized in 646, alongside Asuka (538–710): administrative levels 5–6 and postal stations P.
cards.sourceSnapshot: 1997 documentary edition; Columbia teaching excerpt attributes © 2001 M. E. Sharpe; retrieved 2026-10-06

cards.titleZh: 户籍、土地与赋役：从五十户读起
authors: Asia for Educators, Columbia University (teaching edition)
cards.summaryZh: 第三条要求编立户籍、税籍与授田规则，并以五十户组成一里。第四条进一步列出织物缴纳和劳役供给，串起人户、土地与征收的关系。
cards.summaryEn: Article III prescribes household and tax registers, land allocation, and fifty-household villages. Article IV connects these arrangements to textile dues and labour obligations.
cards.scopeZh: 长篇选段第三、四条；与飞鸟时代文字记录原值P对读，观察年仍为空。
cards.scopeEn: Longer selection, Articles III–IV, alongside Asuka’s written-record row P; its observation date remains unspecified.
cards.sourceSnapshot: 1997 documentary edition; Columbia teaching excerpt attributes © 2001 M. E. Sharpe; retrieved 2026-10-06
